parameters.content:
## 06 VDR Vendor Lead Report (v2, 2026-10-15)
Each due vendor gets a branded Excel file (Summary / Leads / Definitions) of every lead it sent in its lookback window (90 days, whole Eastern days by LP entry date), with Five9 calls, appointment, issue, demo and sale status. Built LIVE by LP-MCP **GET /vdr/report.xlsx** from lp_leads + lp_lead_market_assignments + Five9 (never lp_leads.call_count). Every Summary number is an Excel formula over the Leads tab. No LP lead id, rep or setter names.

**When:** **Schedule: daily 7:15 AM ET** -> Get due vendors. `rpc/vdr_due_vendors` returns active vendors whose slot this PERIOD has passed (weekly: Monday 00:00; monthly: the 1st 00:00) with no sent/no-leads row this period; a blocked or failed vendor is retried by the next daily run, max 3 per period. `week_start` in vdr_send_log is the period start.

**Send now (button):** hover **Send now** and click play. **Send now settings** decides: `test_vendor_id` = a vendor id (default 1, Modernize) sends ONLY that vendor's report to Mark, subject [TEST], logged as a dry-run row, whatever the vendor's settings; `0` sends every vendor due now, for real.

**Checks (nothing sent, logged BLOCKED):** lead sync older than 6h (`stale_lead_sync`; Mark's summary says ACTION NEEDED), the report call failed, the file is another vendor's, a live vendor with no recipients, the rev-share blocks below.

**LP report 135 is a cross-check only (never a blocker).** The Gmail trigger still saves each "Reece Vendor Disposition Feed" email to `vdr_feed_runs` / `vdr_feed_leads` (one row per LP lead, overwritten daily). When a complete saved feed from the last 36h exists, a lead-count gap over 2% is listed in Mark's summary. Keep the subject distinct: I.LPRC watches "Lead Disposition Detail" and 05 watches "Reece Daily Aged Leads Update".

**Vendor settings:** table `vdr_vendor_config` (LP Supabase), edited on the dashboard's Vendor Reports page: sub-sources, To/CC/BCC, frequency, active, dry run, lookback days. Live reports go BCC to m.richard@reecewindows.com plus `recipients_bcc`. DRY RUN = Mark only.

**Log:** `vdr_send_log`, one row per vendor per attempt (`out_file` = the xlsx name, `lead_count` = its rows). Mark gets one summary email per run.

**REV SHARE (2026-10-13).** A vendor with `rev_share=true` (LeadPilot, Contractor Appointment Rev Share) is paid per job RELEASED TO PRODUCTION, so it also gets **Payable Jobs**: every job from its sub-sources whose RTP date fell in the PRIOR Sunday..Saturday pay period (job #, sale amount, job status), as a second CSV next to the XLSX (since 2026-10-15 the lead file no longer carries Job # / RTP date). Data: `rpc/vdr_rev_share_data` — lp_job_milestones (datetype RTP, act_date::date) joined to 133 Jobs By Status (`lp_job_status_history`, latest row per job) by JOB ID; the 135 lead id is job_status.lp_id. Never join milestones.lp_lead_id to a 135 id (different id space); it is only the fallback through lp_jobs -> lp_leads to attribute an RTP job 133 has not reported yet.
**Ledger:** `vdr_payable_jobs`, one row per job actually emailed, unique (vendor_id, lp_job_id, dry_run): a job is listed once, ever (dry run and live separately). Already-listed jobs are skipped and counted in the summary.
**Rev-share blocks (that vendor only):** rtp_data_stale (milestones not synced in 24h), job_status_data_stale (no 133 contract in 3 days), rtp_jobs_without_source (an RTP job in the period that is this vendor's by LP lead source but missing from 133, or has no source at all), rev_share_data_unavailable. Zero payable jobs is valid: lead report still goes, body says so, no empty CSV. Cancelled-looking payable jobs are sent and flagged in Mark's summary, never dropped.

nodes.name: Get rev-share data
nodes.notes: Rev share (2026-10-13): per active rev-share vendor the prior Sun..Sat pay period, its payable jobs (lp_job_milestones RTP x 133 Jobs By Status by job id), every RTP of its jobs, and the health facts the build fails closed on.

nodes.name: Write payable ledger
nodes.notes: One vdr_payable_jobs row per payable job whose email went out. The unique index (vendor_id, lp_job_id, dry_run) + ignore-duplicates means a job can never be listed twice.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger: Reece Vendor Disposition Feed
Prepare feed for database
nodes.notes: One row per LP lead (the row the builder keeps), chunks of 2,000. A bad feed is not saved.

nodes.name: Save feed chunk
nodes.notes: One request per chunk. Upserts vdr_feed_leads on lead_id: each feed overwrites, never duplicates.

nodes.name: Finish saved feed
nodes.notes: Marks the run complete only when every lead it carried is stored.

nodes.name: Send now
nodes.notes: Click to run by hand. "Send now settings" decides: a test vendor id sends that vendor's report to Mark only; 0 sends every vendor due now, for real.

nodes.name: Schedule: daily 7:15 AM ET
nodes.notes: Vendor Lead Report v2 (2026-10-15): the run no longer waits on the LP 135 email. Daily at 7:15 AM ET (workflow time zone); vdr_due_vendors decides who is due.

nodes.name: Send now settings
nodes.notes: test_vendor_id: a vendor id (1 = Modernize) sends ONLY that vendor's report, to Mark only, marked [TEST]. 0 = send every vendor due now, for real.

nodes.name: Get test vendor
nodes.notes: Reads the one vendor named in Send now settings. Changes nothing.

nodes.name: Get vendor report
nodes.notes: LP-MCP GET /vdr/report.xlsx: the branded workbook from live data, one vendor at a time. Auth: the LP Supabase service-role key (LP-MCP checks it against the database; the file is lead PII). An error passes through and the vendor is logged BLOCKED (report_unavailable).
